name: The Hollow
canonRule: The Hollow is not one of the seven playable Realm civilizations. It is a cross-campaign enemy faction, event pressure system, and Gate-born anti-civilization used in missions, Elite remixes, raids, ascension modifiers, and seasonal events.
philosophy: Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
culture: No civilization, no oath, no bloodline. The Hollow imitates the shape of cultures it consumes, then uses those shapes as weapons against the Realms that remember them.
visualIdentity: Charcoal-black absence, white fracture cracks, unfinished masks, inverted ash, torn banners, missing faces, negative-space wounds, dim anti-light seams, broken Gate stone embedded in bodies.
combatPhilosophy: Pressure morale, isolate Titans, corrupt objectives, punish overextension, duplicate forgotten battlefield roles, and turn terrain memory into hostile rules.
factionPassive: Hollowing: when a Hollow unit damages an isolated Titan or corrupted objective, nearby Hollow units gain pressure, silence, or memory-drain effects until cleansed.
eventUse: Can seed any campaign as a threat pool without changing player faction identity. Use tags to select Hollow swarms, anchors, commanders, siege threats, assassins, and world-event bosses.
counterplay: Do not let Wretches mark isolated Titans
Prioritize Standard Bearers and Choir units before swarms
